summary.text: A Royal Navy squadron forced the Lagos bar and shelled the town for three days. Oba Kosoko fled east to Epe, and the British installed his rival Akitoye, who signed a treaty against the slave trade. A decade of consular rule followed, and in 1861 Oba Dosunmu, under threat of bombardment, ceded Lagos to the Crown.

routes.label: Royal Navy ships force the bar and shell the town

moments.title: Lagos bombarded
moments.text: Three days of shelling and fighting; much of the town burns.

moments.title: Treaty with Akitoye
moments.text: The new Oba signs a treaty abolishing the slave trade at Lagos.

moments.title: Lagos ceded
moments.text: Oba Dosunmu signs the cession: Lagos becomes a British colony, the first in what is now Nigeria.
